observations.behavior: Adds a new test case and its supporting helper, and the implementation of a fresh-claim retry path.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds regression tests for the inbox report claiming workflow, specifically the scenario where a user claims a report while the page still shows an out-of-date list row. This could help prevent regressions in the inbox report claiming behavior.
Adds the retrieval API dependency required for the new fresh-claim implementation.

observations.behavior: Adds a new async function claimFromFreshReport that fetches the current report state and claims it, returning the result or null on failure.
